name: @monigo/sdk
description: Official Monigo JavaScript / TypeScript SDK — event ingestion, metering, billing, and usage for browser and Node.js
author: Monigo <dev@monigo.co>

scripts.release:patch: npm run build && npm run test:run && npm version patch && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:minor: npm run build && npm run test:run && npm version minor && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:major: npm run build && npm run test:run && npm version major && git push --follow-tags && npm publish --access public
